scope: D2 depthwise 2x3 attribution on existing train and validation only

decision: Quantify architecture D(w)-A(w), loss A(w)-A(0), and total D(w)-A(0) paired effects; report mean/sample SD and seed directions for all weights. No validation-based change to frozen P2 gate.
